title: DriftSense
description: DriftSense: a CPU-only pipeline that finds a reference pattern in SEM frames under unknown 8–12× zoom and ±5° rotation, or reports it absent. F1 0.91 and AUC 0.99 on 2,250 pairs.
lede: A wafer-inspection microscope loses track of where it is. DriftSense finds a reference pattern inside the SEM frame under unknown 8–12× zoom and ±5° rotation, or reports that it isn't there.

blocks.text: This is Applied Materials' Navigation-Error Recovery problem, Phase 2. Given a high-resolution reference patch and a low-resolution SEM search frame of a repeating semiconductor layout, locate the patch and report its position, rotation and scale, or report that it is not there. The zoom is unknown, between 8× and 12×, and the rotation is unknown within ±5°. About 20% of pairs contain no true instance.

The layout repeats, so a patch correlates well at many positions and local appearance alone cannot identify the site. The pipeline keeps the top few pose hypotheses from a coarse scale sweep, verifies each at full resolution with ZNCC, and keeps the best one.

art: ├─▶ multi-scale sweep (8–12×, ±5°) ─▶ siamese correlation CNN ─▶ top-k peaks
«found: x, y, scale, θ»              «reject: not present»
CAD layout ──▶ Fourier-domain registration ──▶ sub-pixel offset  (separate path)
blocks.caption: Two paths. Matching: a sweep over scale and rotation feeds a siamese correlation network; the top candidates are verified by ZNCC at full resolution, and a pair that fails the score is reported as not present. Registration: CAD-to-SEM alignment in the Fourier domain.

blocks.text: The F1 and AUC pairs are self-generated. The 600 registration pairs come from the organisers' own CAD pipeline and were scored locally on their published rubric.

items: An earlier 81.45 / 81.93 result was withdrawn after a generator defect was found: a severity pinned to one value produced pairs at severity 0.0. It is not reported here.
The organisers' blind set is 200 pairs and is not reproduced here, so the F1 margin may not carry over.
Periodic layouts produce plausible wrong-scale and wrong-rotation matches. Sub-pixel refinement cannot recover a pair whose candidates never include the correct pose.
Some confidently wrong predictions score above the threshold, and no confidence cut catches all of them.
CAD-to-SEM registration assumes a whole-canvas search design file. Without it, the fallback scored 45.32 / 85 on the harsh tier, against 85.00 with it.
Runtime rows are local emulations of the 4-core, 8 GB reference box, not measurements on it.
